title: Apply Show nulls as zero after numeric parsing fails
answers: Why does a SQL chart series contain NaN?
Should Show nulls as zero handle the string 'NaN'?
How should unparseable y-axis values be handled?
body:
Symptom: An unparseable SQL result such as the string 'NaN' becomes NaN in the chart series instead of following Show nulls as zero.
Root cause: frontend/src/queries/nodes/DataVisualization/dataVisualizationLogic.ts:dataVisualizationLogic (yData selector) checked input values but did not validate the parsed number.
Fix pattern: Check Number.isNaN(parsed) after numeric conversion and return showNullsAsZero ? 0 : null when parsing fails.
Constraints: Apply this fallback to invalid or missing y-axis values; preserve valid numeric precision regardless of configured decimal places.
applies: SQL insight y-axis numeric parsing and Show nulls as zero behavior.
